sources.articleTitle: Explosion at Afghanistan school kills seven students, wounds 97 people
Explosion near Afghan school kills seven students

headline: Explosion At Afghanistan School Results In Seven Student Deaths
metaDescription: Seven students died and nearly 100 people were injured following an explosion at a school in Afghanistan caused by a nearby mining explosives depot.
aiSummaryBullets: An explosives storage facility operated by mining companies detonated near an Afghan school.
Official reports confirm seven students were killed in the incident.
Nearly 100 additional people sustained injuries as a result of the blast.
aiContextParagraph: A significant explosion occurred near an educational facility in Afghanistan, resulting in multiple casualties. According to reports from authorities, the blast was triggered by an explosives depot associated with mining operations located in the vicinity of the school. The incident has left seven students dead, while nearly 100 other individuals suffered injuries of varying severity. Emergency response efforts were initiated following the event to provide medical assistance to the large number of affected people. The proximity of industrial explosive materials to populated areas like schools has been identified as the primary factor in the tragedy. Local officials are continuing to gather details on the circumstances surrounding the storage of these materials and the impact the detonation had on the school community and surrounding region.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by multiple independent media outlets and has generated steady coverage velocity, indicating significant regional interest.
